g.text: LedgerCore — Redis Projection, Version Guard, Reconciliation & Backfill
Eventually Consistent Read-Side Caching, Atomic Lua Version Guards, Self-Healing State Reconciliation & Orphan Cleanup
Handles Deposit, Withdrawal, Transfer Source & Transfer Dest events
Stores cached financial balance for sub-millisecond API read access
Used by Lua script to enforce strict version monotonicity
Compares PostgreSQL authoritative accounts against Redis read projections
Triggered when MISSING_FROM_REDIS or MISMATCH is detected during audit.
1. Reads authoritative balance & version from PostgreSQL accounts table
2. Invokes Redis service to populate keys: balance & version
Restores full eventual consistency without application downtime!
Triggered when ORPHANED_IN_REDIS keys are found during reconciliation.
1. Performs double-check verification against PostgreSQL DB
SAFETY: Never executes FLUSHALL or FLUSHDB; zero collateral risk!
• Strong ACID Guarantees with serializable isolation & optimistic locks
• Persists Account Balances, Immutable Ledger Journal & Outbox Events
AUTHORITATIVE STATE — Survives infrastructure re-boots & crashes.
• Decouples synchronous API transactions from read-side indexing
• Guarantees key-ordered delivery per account partition
• High-throughput read model serving balance queries in <1ms
• Version-guarded by Lua scripts & continuously audited by background tasks
READ PROJECTION — Eventually consistent with PostgreSQL.
Balance and version keys are set atomically inside Redis single-threaded engine. No intermediate or un-versioned states are ever visible to readers.
Stale or out-of-order Kafka events (incomingVer <= currentVer) are rejected automatically, guaranteeing cache balance never regresses to a past state.
The scheduled auditor continuously verifies state agreement across PostgreSQL and Redis, auto-repairing missing or drifted keys via backfillAccount.
Orphaned keys undergo DB confirmation before explicit key deletion. The system never executes destructive global commands like FLUSHALL.
